status_note: Frozen 2026-11-18 on team sign-off (all 'team_decisions' confirmed), after foil review rounds 1-2 and before any CLIP score was computed. Any change needs a new config version.
cohort: R1-accepted confirmation sources (98 of 100); original + horizontal_flip

holistic_reference.note: Two-way relation predictions per image on the same 196 images; used only for the descriptive cross-tab, never pooled with recognition accuracy.

article_rule: vlm_probe.depth.natural.article (a/an by first letter); COCO category names kept verbatim, singular

foil_rule.pool: 80 COCO instance categories from the frozen instances_val2014.json
exclude: category_a and category_b of the source
every category annotated anywhere in the source image (COCO instances, any iscrowd)
categories listed with the replaced object in contested_pairs
foil_rule.tier_1: same COCO supercategory as the replaced object
foil_rule.tier_2: any other eligible category (used only when tier 1 is empty)
foil_rule.revision: a 'revise' decision moves to the next ranked candidate for that source/role in a new review round; all versions are kept

contested_pairs_note: Only names a human could reasonably apply to the same object (near-synonym, sub-type or part-whole). Merely hard foils (cat/dog, sheep/cow) stay allowed. The team may edit this list before freeze, never after seeing scores.

review.unit: source (both variants share one centre crop; the flip is its mirror)
review.region_shown: baseline 224x224 centre canvas (shorter-edge bicubic resize + centre crop), exactly what the model sees
review.adjudication: uncertain or revise rows go to a new round; disagreements adjudicated with history kept

metrics.primary: recognition_accuracy: share of trials with s(true) > s(foil), over all trials of the analysed cohort
metrics.trial: one image x one role; correct iff true caption score > foil caption score
metrics.tie_rule: exact tie counted incorrect and reported separately; |gap| <= 1e-6 reported as near tie
secondary: accuracy by role, by variant, by foil tier
descriptive cross-tab with holistic T2/o0 two-way relation correctness on the same image
metrics.bootstrap_unit: source_image_id (all trials of a source resampled together)

team_decisions.reviewer_note: One human reviewer (tuan_dat) reviewed all 196 round-1 rows and the 13 round-2 rows; no inter-annotator agreement is available.
team_decisions.missing_foil_rule: A source enters the primary analysis only if both roles have an accepted foil; excluded sources are listed with reasons and coverage is reported against all 98
team_decisions.minimum_sources_note: Same floor as natural_confirmation_v1; below this T1 is reported as not feasible and no inference is run

interpretation_thresholds.clearly_good: lower bound of the 95% source-bootstrap CI of recognition_accuracy >= 80%
interpretation_thresholds.note: Chance is 50% (two captions). Thresholds were fixed by the team before scores; they are not derived from a power analysis.

team_decisions.budget: One smoke run and one full run with the existing CLIP ViT-B/32 checkpoint (encode 196 images and the true/foil captions); at most 1 GPU-hour, no fine-tuning
team_decisions.stop_rule: One main run plus at most one pre-registered follow-up; no extra sampling to reach significance
